name: @speedtest/headless
description: Optimized headless Next.js frontend for Elevation Design Studio demo

scripts.predev: npm run sync-tokens && npm run sync-templates
scripts.dev: (graphql-codegen --config codegen.ts && node ./add-ts-nocheck.js) || echo '[codegen] Skipped — run npm run codegen once GraphQL endpoint is healthy'; next dev
scripts.build: NODE_ENV=${NODE_ENV:-production} graphql-codegen --config codegen.ts && node ./add-ts-nocheck.js && NODE_ENV=${NODE_ENV:-production} next build
scripts.build:prod: NODE_ENV=production npm run sync-templates && NODE_ENV=production graphql-codegen --config codegen.ts && node ./add-ts-nocheck.js && next build
